story.title: Our Story
story.text: Founded in Medellín in 2008, Brasaland began as a family dream: sharing the authentic taste of grilled meat with consistent quality and warm service. Today we are 14 restaurants in two countries, but we maintain the same recipe for success: fresh products, traditional techniques, and passion for every dish we serve.
